title: Rows open to customers, then to their invoices and credits
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 2 S2-R1 S2-R2 S2-R4 S2-R3)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $200.00, priced $243.00 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A and B in the Customer filter.
  3. Open tier A's row.
  4. Open customer A's row under tier A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every row shows closed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's row reads Parts Invoiced $486.00 ($121.50 + $243.00 + $121.50).

Step 3:

  • Customer A reads $364.50 ($121.50 + $243.00), 75.00% of total; customer B reads $121.50, 25.00%.
  • $364.50 + $121.50 = $486.00, tier A's figure.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's invoice reads $121.50 (25.00%) and work order 2's $243.00 (50.00%), each with its number and today's date.
  • $121.50 + $243.00 = $364.50, customer A's figure; 25.00% + 50.00% = 75.00%.
